entities.title: ai-agent-rules
entities.summary: `zazzle agent get-rules PATH`: prints the names and text of the rule files (AGENTS.md, AGENTS.override.md, CLAUDE.md, CLAUDE.local.md, .claude/rules at any depth, scoped by their `paths:` globs) and skill files (SKILL.md) that apply to a path, from the home folder and every folder above the path, closest last, with each file a rule imports (`@file`) after it; skills print only their description unless asked, and a CLAUDE.md that only imports listed files is not repeated.
entities.purpose: The crate of the ai-agent-rules binary: Cargo.toml, the user README, and the library, binary and tests in src/. It is one member of the Cargo workspace in src/macos.
boundaries: It prints the files and marked segments that apply but never decides which rules matter to a task.

The zazzle invoker (src/macos/zazzle) runs it for `zazzle ai-agent-rules ARGS` by exec'ing the ai-agent-rules binary from the tools' folder (libexec/zazzle); `zazzle agent get-rules` goes to the daemon, which links this crate as a library.
Packaging ai-agent-rules in releases is the release scripts' concern, not this folder's.

relationships.description: The invoker that execs ai-agent-rules for `zazzle agent`.
